intro.title: Facilities → Locations
lines: Every campsite belongs to a location.
We'll open Portland Parks and configure its campsite
for nightly reservations.
intro.narration: Welcome! Let's configure a campsite that guests book by the night. Campsites live under Locations in the Rec admin.

steps.title: Location · Details
lines: Address, hours of operation, and timezone live here,
plus the default reservation window —
how far ahead guests can book at this location.
steps.narration: A location's Details tab holds the address, hours of operation, timezone, and the default reservation window. Its sites live on the next tab.

steps.title: Location · Sites
lines: Every bookable space at this location.
Create one with New Site, or open an existing site —
our campsite is Dan's Camping Hut.
steps.narration: The Sites tab lists every bookable space at this location. We'll open our campsite — Dan's Camping Hut.

steps.title: Campsite · Basic Site Settings
lines: Site Type: Campsite · kind: Tent & RV, Tent, RV, or Lodging.
Booking Unit → Nightly is the key switch.
Set check-in and check-out times, capacity, and publish.
steps.narration: Set the Site Type to Campsite and pick the kind — tent, R V, or lodging. Then the key switch: Booking Unit, set to Nightly. Add check-in and check-out times, capacity, and publish.

steps.title: Campsite · Instant Book
lines: Let guests book directly on rec.us.
Stay Duration: minimum and maximum nights per stay.
Reservation Dates & Release Times: when dates open up.
steps.narration: Instant Book lets guests book directly on rec dot us. Stay Duration caps the nights per stay — one to five here — and Reservation Dates controls how far out guests can book.

steps.title: Campsite · Add-Ons
lines: Add-ons on a nightly site are priced per night.
Mandatory add-ons apply to every booking;
optional add-ons are the guest's choice.
steps.narration: Add-ons are priced per night. Mandatory add-ons, like this trash disposal fee, apply to every booking; optional ones are the guest's choice.

steps.title: Campsite · Pricing
lines: Set the default price per night and tax.
Pick the GL code so revenue maps to your accounting.
Save — and the campsite is bookable by the night.
steps.narration: Finally, set the default price per night, tax, and the G L code for accounting. Hit Save — your campsite now takes nightly reservations.
